decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The use hereby approved shall only be for the purposes of offices and interview and training for job seekers and for no other purpose.
Condition : 2 - 2.	The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 1 April 2004 when the use shall cease.
Condition : 3 - 3.	The building shall not be used as a social services administration centre until space has been laid out within the site for 5 bicycles to be parked.
Condition : 4 - 4.	Two parking spaces shall be identified for the use of visitors, and the bays clearly marked for such purposes prior to the use commencing and thereafter retained for such use.
Condition : 5 - 5.	Parking shall only take place in the allocated spaces and the service and circulation space shall be permanently retained free of parked vehicles.
description: Change of use to social service administrative office.
